subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which public Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation IDs without breaking existing account-scoped binds?
rationale: The current PR fixes the desired peer shape by changing documented account syntax, while sibling PRs propose different grammar and ownership boundaries; that compatibility choice needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add safe peer handling
options.body: Keep channel-only and channel:account behavior stable, then add an explicit peer form or plugin-owned Feishu recognition with an account escape and docs.

options.title: Adopt additive peer syntax only
options.body: Accept a new channel:kind:id style grammar as a feature, but do not close the original two-segment Feishu bug until that flow is handled separately.

options.title: Use plugin-owned Feishu inference
options.body: Add a typed channel/plugin seam so Feishu owns conversation-id detection instead of hardcoding Feishu policy in the core parser.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add safe peer handling
recommendation.body: Keep channel-only and channel:account behavior stable, then add an explicit peer form or plugin-owned Feishu recognition with an account escape and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent docs/parser/routing maintenance makes this the best available routing owner for the public CLI contract decision.
